title: Ex-SNSD member Jessica Jung makes Korean stage comeback after 12 years

blocks.text: Jessica Jung, formerly of Girls’ Generation, made her first appearance on Korea’s local stage after 12 years as she performed alongside comedian Park Myung-soo. Jung uploaded a picture of her and Park together on stage on her social media account on Sunday, Sept. 20. The duo performed their 2009 hit “Naengmyeon.” “‘Naengmyeon,’ it’s been a while,” wrote the singer alongside photos of her and Park performing the song at the 2026 Infinite Challenge Run in Gyeongju, North Gyeongsang Province, Saturday.
